ideal: Every guard, hook and permission check on Claude earns its keep: it stops real mistakes, rarely blocks safe work, and costs little when it fires.
quality: No blocker costs more than it catches, guard false alarms are rare, and no change to a gate is reverted or causes a bug.
speed: Commit and push hooks finish in seconds, and a pull request needs few pushes.
consumption: A blocked call costs one short answer, and hook output and review subagents add few tokens.
